name: Firefox
description: Firefox's updater verifies the opened MAR against compiled primary/secondary certificate data when MOZ_VERIFY_MAR_SIGNATURE is enabled, then checks MAR channel and version metadata before applying the update.
limitations: Newly retrieved official Mozilla Git mirror default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; the claim is bounded to builds with MOZ_VERIFY_MAR_SIGNATURE and the inspected channel-specific certificate configuration.
